overview: The committee approved a series of space summary reductions for the new high school building project, totaling an estimated $22 million in savings, and established a target for the site's parking program.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from the July 21, 2026, meeting.

items.title: Approval of July 2026 Invoices
items.summary: Approved three invoices totaling $134,354.50 for project management and architectural services.

items.title: Welcome and Onboarding of New Members
items.summary: Welcomed new voting members Liz Mullane, Tracy Keene, and Jen Belanger, and non-voting member Kim Clinton to the committee.

items.title: Sustainability and Systems Advisory Subcommittee Update
items.summary: Received a report on sustainability goals, including LEED Silver certification targets and upcoming lifecycle cost analyses for all-electric HVAC systems.

items.title: Medford Community Media Space Reduction
items.summary: Approved eliminating 1,400 square feet of dedicated studio space for Medford Community Media to utilize a shared model with the vocational program.

items.title: Community Partner Rental Space Reduction
items.summary: Approved eliminating 910 square feet of dedicated storage space for community renters following a school committee policy decision.

items.title: Community Meeting Space Efficiency
items.summary: Approved removing a dedicated multipurpose room and language lab by integrating those functions into flexible Large Group Instruction (LGI) spaces.

items.title: Health and Physical Education Space Reductions
items.summary: Approved eliminating the dedicated yoga/CPR room and reducing locker room square footage by 1,000 square feet.

items.title: Auditorium Seating Reduction
items.summary: Approved reducing auditorium seating capacity from 1,000 to 750 to create a more intimate environment and save 2,500 square feet. This reduction brings the house size into alignment with MSBA reimbursement limits.

items.title: Art and Music Space Efficiencies
items.summary: Approved reducing the digital art lab by 240 square feet by eliminating the traditional darkroom in favor of digital-only instruction.

items.title: Parking Program Recommendation
items.summary: Approved a parking program target of 477 spaces and authorized the school administration to remove program-specific parking if those programs are eliminated from the final design.

items.title: MSBA Feedback and Schematic Design Phase
items.summary: Reviewed feedback from the MSBA on the Preferred Schematic Report and noted the project is scheduled for a vote to formally enter the schematic design phase.

subject: High School Project Space Reductions
